gizmo.title: Kalanda
gizmo.description: Nuna taruka a cikin fayil ɗin kalanda a matsayin katunan kwanan wata, jadawalin lokaci, tebur ko jeri.

configure.title: Fayil ɗin kalanda
configure.description: Ɗora ko zaɓi fayil ɗin kalanda na .ics. Ana karanta tarukansa a cikin burauza.

configure.title: Nuna a matsayin
configure.description: Yadda za a gabatar da abin da fayil ɗin ya ƙunsa.

configure.title: Kanun labari
configure.description: Ana nuna shi a saman taruka, kuma a matsayin taken tebur. Ta tsohuwa yana amfani da sunan kalandar kanta.
